introHtml: Green sun visor clips offer a fresh, recognizable way to keep your brand top-of-mind. Whether you choose the sturdy Power Clip or the versatile Gator® Clip, these clips attach securely to car visors and hold items like sunglasses, masks, or parking passes. Custom imprinting in green ensures your logo stands out against the interior of any vehicle, making them a practical giveaway for trade shows, safety incentives, or employee appreciation programs.
